tracks.name: Miami Beach, FL → Fort Pierce, FL
tracks.notes: Leg 1 of 11. Miami Beach departure via Government Cut, then ICW north.

tracks.name: Fort Pierce, FL → St. Augustine, FL
tracks.notes: Leg 2 of 11. Offshore run up the Florida coast.

tracks.name: St. Augustine, FL → Hilton Head, SC
tracks.notes: Leg 3 of 11. Long offshore run past Georgia.

tracks.name: Hilton Head, SC → Charleston, SC
tracks.notes: Leg 4 of 11. Mixed ICW and coastal.

tracks.name: Charleston, SC → Southport, NC
tracks.notes: Leg 5 of 11. Offshore past the South Carolina/North Carolina border.

tracks.name: Southport, NC → Jarratt Bay, NC
tracks.notes: Leg 6 of 11. Mixed run through NC waters.

tracks.name: Jarratt Bay, NC → Coinjock, NC
tracks.notes: Leg 7 of 11. NC Outer Banks run.

tracks.name: Hampton Bay, VA → Ocean City, MD
tracks.notes: Leg 9 of 11. Offshore up the Delmarva Peninsula.

tracks.name: Ocean City, MD → New York, NY
tracks.notes: Leg 10 of 11. Offshore run past NJ, into NY Harbor.

tracks.name: New York, NY → East Falmouth, MA
tracks.notes: Leg 11 of 11. Final offshore leg to Cape Cod via Long Island Sound and Buzzards Bay.

tracks.name: Falmouth, MA to Jersey City, NJ
